phaser-concept.title: Synchronize staged work with Phaser
phaser-concept.summary: Phaser is a synchronization aid for multi-phase work whose set of registered participants can change dynamically.
phaser-concept.why: It keeps phase numbers and participant arrival together when several tasks must rendezvous repeatedly.
phaser-concept.tips: Keep registration and deregistration balanced, and use arriveAndDeregister when a participant is finished.

collections-ncopies.title: Create a List containing n copies of one element
collections-ncopies.summary: Collections.nCopies returns an unmodifiable List containing n references to the specified element.
collections-ncopies.why: It expresses a simple repeated value without a manual population loop.
collections-ncopies.tips: The element object itself is not cloned, and the returned List does not support add operations.

closed-channel-exception.title: Operating on a closed Channel
closed-channel-exception.short: Do not use a Channel after close
closed-channel-exception.summary: ClosedChannelException is a checked exception raised when an I/O operation requires a Channel that has already been closed.
closed-channel-exception.why: A closed Channel has ended its connection to the I/O resource and cannot be reopened for reuse.
closed-channel-exception.tips: Bound its lifetime with try-with-resources and avoid leaking the Channel outside that scope.

multicatch-related-alternatives-error.title: Related exception types cannot share a multi-catch
multicatch-related-alternatives-error.short: Do not combine parent and child exception types
multicatch-related-alternatives-error.summary: A multi-catch cannot list exception alternatives when one type is a subclass of another alternative.
multicatch-related-alternatives-error.why: Catching the parent already catches the child, so the child alternative would be redundant.
multicatch-related-alternatives-error.tips: Catch only the common parent, or use separate catch clauses when the handling must differ.

auxiliary-class-access-warning.title: Accessing an auxiliary class from another source file
auxiliary-class-access-warning.short: Keep top-level classes in matching source files
auxiliary-class-access-warning.summary: With auxiliaryclass lint enabled, javac can warn when code accesses a top-level class declared in a different source file from the one named after it.
auxiliary-class-access-warning.why: Such source layout makes compilation dependencies less obvious and can make builds fragile.
auxiliary-class-access-warning.tips: Put each externally used top-level class in its own matching .java file.

identityhashmap-equality-trap.title: IdentityHashMap does not compare keys with equals
identityhashmap-equality-trap.short: Do not confuse reference identity with logical equality
identityhashmap-equality-trap.summary: IdentityHashMap compares keys using == rather than equals, giving it different equality semantics from ordinary Map implementations.
identityhashmap-equality-trap.why: Two distinct instances with equal contents are treated as two different keys.
identityhashmap-equality-trap.tips: Use HashMap for ordinary value-based keys and reserve IdentityHashMap for cases that explicitly require reference identity.

exchanger-concept.title: Exchange values between two threads with Exchanger
exchanger-concept.short: Rendezvous two threads and swap values
exchanger-concept.summary: Exchanger is a synchronization point where two threads meet and receive each other's supplied value.
exchanger-concept.why: It provides an explicit handoff point for two-party workflows such as producer and processor stages.
exchanger-concept.tips: If only one side reaches exchange it waits, so design shutdown and exceptional paths as well.

arrays-setall.title: Fill an array from its indexes
arrays-setall.summary: Arrays.setAll assigns every array element using a function that receives the element index.
arrays-setall.why: It expresses index-dependent initialization without a manual assignment loop.
arrays-setall.tips: The function runs for each index, so keep it focused on computing the element rather than unrelated side effects.

cancelled-key-exception.title: Operating on a cancelled SelectionKey
cancelled-key-exception.short: Do not operate on an invalid SelectionKey
cancelled-key-exception.summary: CancelledKeyException is thrown when an operation requiring a valid SelectionKey is attempted after that key has been cancelled.
cancelled-key-exception.why: A cancelled key is scheduled to be removed from its Selector registration and cannot have operations such as interestOps changed.
cancelled-key-exception.tips: Check isValid before operations and do not reuse a key after cancelling it.

multicatch-parameter-assignment-error.title: A multi-catch parameter cannot be reassigned
multicatch-parameter-assignment-error.short: The multi-catch parameter is implicitly final
multicatch-parameter-assignment-error.summary: The exception parameter of a multi-catch clause cannot be assigned another exception object.
multicatch-parameter-assignment-error.why: A parameter representing multiple alternative exception types is treated as implicitly final.
multicatch-parameter-assignment-error.tips: Keep the caught exception reference unchanged and introduce another local variable if a separate value is needed.
